risk_summary: The disclosure presents severe liquidity and solvency risk, including exhausted cash, a $13.6 million working capital deficit, $105.0 million accumulated deficit, substantial payroll-tax liabilities, and explicit going-concern doubt. Reported net income was driven largely by a $2.26 million gain from expired payroll-tax liabilities rather than recurring operations, while future financing and customer orders remain uncertain. Extensive boilerplate and forward-looking disclaimers somewhat dilute the otherwise clearly negative risk profile.
